hypothesis: This is the matched-horizon reference for the seed-23 data_seed 0 ceiling test. Setup: m2 fixed at 0.5, N=64, seed 23, 4 layers, d_model=64, e in [0, 0.5], best-of-3 controls, 24000 steps. Prediction: the final layer-1 trained force R2 (probes_final, unrounded) stays at least 0.04 above the same-layer 24000-step N=128 seed-23 value of 0.71286 (run-20261014-070746-d284, layer 1). If so, the N=128 deficit is a lower ceiling at matched layer and horizon. The N=64 best-margin layer is reported, and a best layer other than 1 is flagged as cross-layer. Intermediate values are read only as same-layer (layer 1) control plus margin, never from the max-over-layers trajectory field. Horizon check: the step-12000 layer-1 value must be within 0.03 of the 12000-step N=64 seed-23 run's layer-1 value of 0.7935 (run-20261014-043150-2de3). If it is not, the result is reported as horizon-confounded. Both reference run IDs are cited as evidence. Secondary, descriptive only: whether this run's 24000-step endpoint is below the 12000-step endpoint (0.7935), as happened for seed 22 (0.804 vs 0.840).
expected_if_true: Final layer-1 force R2 >= 0.753 (gap >= 0.04 vs 0.71286). Force beats its control (margin >= 0.1). Step-12000 layer-1 value within 0.03 of 0.7935. Headroom-normalised accel_step margin in [0.60, 0.85].
expected_if_false: Final layer-1 force R2 <= 0.733 (gap <= 0.02 vs 0.71286), meaning the N=128 deficit closes at matched horizon. A gap between 0.02 and 0.04, or a failed horizon check, is reported as inconclusive.
